summary: 00A13B60, the CLOSEATTACK and DEFENDPOSITION tick, read for its collect radius, its member gate, its four-factor candidate score and its order site. It refutes three claims of docs/AI_COMMAND_TICK.md: it issues attackmove (00E08F78) to a ship member and settarget (00E08EF8) to any other served member, both through 0077D600 with a kind-1 descriptor that names an OBJECT, and the cautious pass 00A14DD0 issues a third class, clearorders. The score is the target weight times a range factor that falls from 1.0 at CloseAttack_NearDist to 0.0 at CloseAttack_FarDist, times 10 for a member of the command's target group and 1.8 for the member's existing target.

__thiscall(group)(entity) -> bool. 00A2C720 MOV EAX,[ECX+5640h], 00A2C728 takes the entity from [ESP+0Ch], 00A2C72D LEA ESI,[ECX+563Ch] is the sentinel. CALL at 00A146B5 with the command's +1Ch target group in ECX and the candidate pushed at 00A146B4.

RET 14h, five stack arguments. 00419010 FLD [ESP+0Ch] and 00419016 FLD [ESP+4] are the two x-endpoints and 00419026 returns [ESP+8] when they are equal, so the order is (x0, y0, x1, y1, x). At the call site the stack holds NearDist, 1.0f, FarDist, 0.0f and the distance, so the factor is 1.0 inside NearDist falling to 0.0 at FarDist.

corrections: docs/AI_COMMAND_TICK.md: 'the command descriptor is always 00E08F68', 'no AI command class issues any other scene command' and 'the descriptor carries a point, never an object' are all wrong. 00A13B60 issues 00E08F78 or 00E08EF8 with an object descriptor at 00A14A6E, and 00A14DD0 issues 00E08F08. The earlier packet read 00A02020 and stopped at 00A13B60, which is why the three claims looked right.

docs/AI_COMMAND_TICK.md's follow-up entry ai_command_engage_pass described 00A13B60 as 'what CLOSEATTACK and DEFENDPOSITION do with the point, the target group and the radius'. The radius is a multiplier on CloseAttack_CollectDist, not a radius in world units, and the point is the centre the candidates are collected around.

validation.attribution: USN02's attack group is fourteen ships led by DeRuyter, it promotes to CLOSEATTACK early, and every later command tick serves its members: the 559 attackmove orders plus 57 fallbacks plus the 5 the move-to-attack arm already issued plus the original 14 make the 635. The gunnery rise from 161 hits and 19061.0 damage to 168 and 20721.4 follows, with deaths and kill credits unchanged. IJN01 and USN01 serve nobody because their attack groups are individual aircraft, and the member gate admits only a plane squadron or a ship base; every census on those two is unchanged. settarget is never issued because the only served members here are ships. The pilot-attack table is unchanged on all three, since the new orders go to ships.

The +538h object's vtable[+2Ch] busy test at 00A1443D has no producer here and answers false, so no served member is ever skipped for being busy.
